messages:
anya: Hey team — drafting the v1 -> v2 deprecation notice for the public API and SDKs. Putting the draft PR here for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234. Can folks check examples + migration snippets?

olivia: Thanks — quick skim. We need a short migration checklist at the top (breaking params, endpoints, auth change). I'll add a bullet list. :+1:

sam: Key breaking changes to call out:
- REST: /v1/generate -> /v2/generate (renamed param `model` -> `model_id`)
- SDKs: Python client.constructor args changed from api_key=... to token=...
- Streaming API now uses SSE vs chunked responses (example needed)

mike: I can patch the JS snippets. Suggest replacing old snippet: 
```js
// v1
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-xx', prompt: 'hi' })
```
with this for v2:
```js
// v2
const res = await client.generate({ model_id: 'gpt-xx', prompt: 'hi' })
```
Also mention `client.close()` is required in Node long-polling.

anya: @mike perfect. @olivia can you add the checklist at the top? Also add a short sample migration table mapping old -> new param names.

olivia: On it. I'll add table + quick copy-paste snippets for Python and Go.

james: Heads-up: the model swap note — when switching from red-1 to red-2 there are slight tokenization differences that can change output. We should link to the model diff page and recommend a small eval set.

anya: Good catch. Link: https://internal.redwood/models/red-2/diffs. Add recommendation: run 50 prompt checks and flag quality regressions.

sam: Also need to update the CLI docs: `redwoodctl infer --model` -> `redwoodctl infer --model-id`. People copy CLI examples verbatim.

mike: PR updated with JS changes — pushed a new commit and left inline comments for the Python snippets.

docs-bot: Reminder: staging site preview is available at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.dev/1234 — please review before merge.

olivia: I noticed a broken internal link in the rollback section that pointed to the old admin console guide. I'll swap to the new console docs and add a redirect note.

anya: Timeline question — when do we want to start the deprecation notice? Ops recommended a 60-day window plus 30 days soft-deprecation where we return header warning. CS needs time to prepare. @cs-team can you confirm readiness?

cs-team: We can draft customer emails and support FAQ within 5 business days if we get the final wording. Need the exact date and canned TL;DR for CSMs.

anya: Proposed public announcement: 2026-05-01 start of deprecation header, 2026-07-01 enforcement (v1 disabled for new tokens, legacy tokens have redirects for 30 days). Thoughts?

james: Sounds reasonable. Add a migration helper script to docs (curl + sed examples) so SREs can easily bulk-update configs.

sam: I'll author the sed/curl helper and paste into the migration appendix. Example: 
```bash
# replace param name in config files
sed -i 's/model:/model_id:/' /etc/myapp/config.yml
```

mike: Need to call out SDK semver bumps. The Python package will go from 1.x -> 2.0.0. We should list the exact CHANGELOG excerpts in the deprecation page.

olivia: I'll add a changelog snippet and mention the pip install command: `pip install redwood-sdk==2.0.0` with upgrade notes.

anya: Great. One more: please add a short section for webhooks that mentions the payload field `model` -> `model_id` rename and a migration webhook sample.

mike: Will add a small JSON example of the new webhook payload.

docs-bot: CI status: docs build passed, linkcheck found 1 external 404 (fixed by olivia commit).

changelog-bot: New release note draft created: https://go.redwood/release/456 — please review for accuracy.

olivia: I've finished the checklist and the table, plus the redirect note. PR is ready for final review.

anya: Final ask: when we merge, please ping #general and the status page. I'll also schedule a short customer webinar and a blog post draft.

sam: Lgtm. Approving the PR.

mike: Approved. Merging in ~10m after the staging check.

anya: Thanks all. After merge, @cs-team will get the canned FAQ and I'll coordinate the external announcement. :rocket:
